content:
Brydge is an Apple accessory company that came back from the dead back in 2023 and has just announced a brand new line of colorful keyboards for the entry-level iPad.

While the iPad itself comes in four colors, its Magic Keyboard only comes in white. This is what prompted Brydge to launch its newest lineup…

The 11-inch basic model iPad comes in silver, blue, pink and yellow. Brydge is now launching what it describes as premium aluminum keyboards to match those colors.

The company says its product offers the build quality and features that Brydge is known for, including a sturdy aluminum construction, a full-size backlit keyboard with 1.3mm of key travel, an all-glass multi-touch trackpad that supports all iPadOS gestures, and strong magnets to keep the iPad in place. Bluetooth automatically reconnects when you open the case.

Battery life is said to last up to three months without backlighting, or 40 hours total with backlighting enabled, and it charges via USB-C.

The keyboard, called the Brydge 11.0, is compatible with the iPad (10th generation) and iPad (A16), and is priced at $159. By comparison, Apple's Magic Keyboard Folio is priced at $249. The lineup is expected to launch in the middle of the month on the company's website and official Amazon store.
